palette: Rich crimson-brown core, dark bark-brown ridges, and warm amber grain.
valueRange: Deep warm values with a brighter living center.
surfaceAndWear: Old dense grain, naturally interlocked fibers, polished growth ridges, healed knots.
constructionVocabulary: Organic curves grown around the load path, branch-like braces, carved rings, integrated knots.
supernaturalBehavior: A faint warm pulse visible only in a few grain channels.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Dark leather, black cord, steel caps, and muted bronze.
neighborDifference: More organic and visibly vital than Ironwood; less spectral and weightless than Spiritwood.
